description: This file defines the AssignClaimRequestController class, which manages the assignment of claim requests within the HR management system. It handles HTTP requests, includes permission checks, and prepares Vue.js components for the user interface related to claim assignment.

classes.name: AssignClaimRequestController
classes.description: Controller responsible for handling claim assignment interface and logic, including permission checks and pre-render setup.

methods.name: preRender
methods.description: Prepares the Vue component with claim and employee data for rendering, performing access control and redirects as necessary.

methods.name: isCapable
methods.description: Checks whether the current request has the necessary permissions to access or modify the claim request.
